annotations.title: Zeekeo: Create Campaign (starts real LinkedIn automation)

description: Creates a Zeekeo LinkedIn campaign: sends a connection invite using invite_template_id, and optionally — if followup_template_id is given — waits for the invite to be accepted, then sends a follow-up message using that template. Create templates first with zeekeo_create_template. Provide exactly one of filter_url (a LinkedIn search results URL) or profile_urls (specific profiles) as the target. This starts REAL LinkedIn automation once the campaign has profiles in it — confirm with the user before calling. Requires the user to have connected their own Zeekeo Launchpad account. Direct them to rankparse.com/dashboard/integrations to connect it.

exclude_first_degree_connections.description: Skip people already connected to the user (default true)

exclude_past_campaigns_targets.description: Skip people already targeted in a previous campaign (default true)

filter_url.description: A LinkedIn search results URL to source profiles from. Provide this or profile_urls, not both.

followup_delay_hours.description: Hours to wait after connection before the follow-up (default 24)

followup_template_id.description: Template id from zeekeo_create_template (type linkedin_message) for a follow-up message sent after the invite is accepted. Omit for an invite-only campaign. Must be a linkedin_message template — email_message and linkedin_inmail templates are not valid here.

invite_delay.description: Seconds to wait before the first invite (default 0)

profile_urls.description: Specific LinkedIn profile URLs to target. Provide this or filter_url, not both.

name: zeekeo_create_campaign
